assessment: The primary meeting presentation tests survival of Artemia salina nauplii exposed in culture vessels to saliva or serum in a cystic-fibrosis diagnostic assay. There is no boiled shrimp dietary exposure or patient fall-frequency endpoint in that presentation.

primary_locator: https://cdn.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/blobs/05a6/464082/afbe9d176d61/thorax00370-0121.png (Printed p. 885, Thien et al, Effects of dietary fish oil supplementation on seasonal asthma in pollen sensitive asthmatics)
assessment: The double-blind seasonal asthma trial uses oil specified as olive oil in the placebo control. It compares bronchial reactivity, wheeze, cough and nasal symptoms with fish oil supplementation. The formulation is unspecified and the measured clinical outcomes concern asthma rather than swallowing severity.
